title: Samples smoke test output and action items
content:
Meeting: Developer Experience — Quickstarts & Samples smoke-test day
Date: 2026-02-12
Facilitator: Aisha Patel
Attendees: Miguel S, Jin P, Lena H, Tomás R, Aisha P (notes)
Zoom: (recording linked in GH PR)
Purpose: run a lightweight, pragmatic smoke-test across our quickstarts, SDK examples, and sample templates to catch regressions before the v0.9 docs push. Focus areas: installer/CLI, first-run notebooks, streaming example, environment docs, telemetry opt-in behavior.

TL;DR
- Ran 10 discrete smoke checks across linux/mac/windows-wsl CI images and a macbook M1 dev VM. 6 passed, 4 failed (2 flaky).
- Most significant failures: installer permission error on Windows paths; streaming sample crashes on long messages (related to kv cache shape mismatch); README quickstart had outdated env var name (REDWOOD_API -> REDWOOD_API_KEY).
- Action items assigned and triaged to PRs/Jira. Aim: all critical fixes merged by Feb 19, 2026.

Smoke-test checklist (what we ran)
1) npm/yarn global quickstart install -> verify `redwood quickstart init` CLI launches and prints help.
2) python pipline: pip install redwood-sdk[dev] -> import redwood; send simple generate("hello")
3) docker-compose local sample -> run with env file -> call /generate endpoint -> response within 1s
4) Notebook (notebooks/quickstart.ipynb) -> kernel start -> cell 3 (auth) -> embedding example runs
5) Streaming chat example (samples/streaming-demo) -> stream 200-token reply -> ensure chunked updates
6) Windows path copy -> install + sample run under C:\Users\Default\AppData\Local\redwood -> ensure no permission or 
path encoding errors
7) Telemetry opt-in flow -> env var REDWOOD_TELEMETRY=0/1 -> check no telemetry when 0
8) README quickstart env var name validation -> docs link works, example uses correct var name
9) Samples packaging -> tarball of samples builds on CI and unpacks with correct file permissions
10) CI smoke test matrix -> reproduce CI matrix locally (ubuntu-22-04, macos-12, windows-2022)

Results summary (quick matrix)
- 1) CLI help: PASS (linux/mac). FAIL (windows) - installer path collision on older chocolatey installs, see GH issue 4812.
- 2) Python import/generate: PASS on linux/mac, FLAKY on mac M1 for wheels w/o universal2 build.
- 3) Docker sample: PASS (but environment variable naming mismatch surfaced in logs).
- 4) Notebook: PASS after bumping ipykernel to 6.18.
- 5) Streaming demo: FAIL reproducible when seq len > 1024, crash stack shows kv cache dim mismatch in runtime call (probable mismatch between sample model variant and runtime kernel selection).
- 6) Windows path: FAIL - PermissionError when tmpdir uses long path with non-ascii characters.
- 7) Telemetry opt-in: PASS functional but docs example uses REDWOOD_API var; found ambiguous UX (should mention explicit TELEMETRY env).
- 8) README var: FAIL - docs example uses REDWOOD_API not REDWOOD_API_KEY. Small doc fix but high impact for first-run.
- 9) Packaging: PASS (tarball), but file mode bits not preserved in some unzip clients -> low priority.
- 10) CI matrix repro: PARTIAL - windows reproduction failed due to local permissions, need clean hosted runner to replicate.

Notes / quick diagnostics
- Streaming crash: stack excerpt (sanitized): RuntimeError: kv cache shape [12,16,2048] vs expected [12,16,1024] -> suggests model variant used in sample was 2k context but runtime binding assumed 1k. Action: enforce model pinning in sample config and add assert in sample harness to catch mismatch before runtime call.
- Windows installer: chocolatey/winget wrappers set Home to C:\Users\default which has character set issues for some path joins. Short-term: document workaround (set REDWOOD_CACHE_DIR) + file a dependency issue for windows wrapper.
- M1 wheels: CI has universal2 wheel build in progress (PR linked). Until merged, add a troubleshooting note to quickstart for mac M1: pip install --no-binary :all: redwood-sdk (slower but works).

Decisions made during meeting
- Do not delay v0.9 docs release for packaging or tarbit mode bits issue (low priority).
- Must block release on streaming crash and windows installer permission bug. Both marked P0 for quickstarts.
- Documentation must be updated to use explicit env var names: REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_TELEMETRY with example values.

Action items (owner - what - due)
- Miguel Santos - GH PR to pin model variant in streaming-demo and add preflight assert (PR #412) - due 2026-02-15.
- Jin Park - Reproduce Windows installer issue on hosted windows runner, capture logs, and create follow-up issue for winget/choco integration (JIRA DEXP-129) - due 2026-02-14.
- Lena Hoffman - Update quickstart READMEs and examples to use REDWOOD_API_KEY and add troubleshooting mac M1 note (doc PR) - due 2026-02-16.
- Tomás Rivera - Add telemetry UX blurb to quickstart (how to opt-in/out) and add test step to CI matrix - due 2026-02-16.
- Aisha Patel - Coordinate a follow-up smoke run after PRs merge; run subset of tests and sign-off for docs release readiness - tentative 2026-02-19.

Open questions / unresolved
- Do we want to surface model pinning in the quickstart by default or hide behind a flag? (tradeoff: simplicity vs reproducibility). Agree to pin in samples and add comment explaining why.
- How to handle telemetry opt-in ergonomics long-term? Propose a small design doc for email/UX team.

Follow-ups scheduled
- Quick recheck sync: 2026-02-17 09:00 PT (15m) - owners only to confirm PRs landed and CI green.
- Full smoke re-run: 2026-02-19 10:00 PT (30m) - capture recording and link in PR description.

Notes to self (working doc style)
- Capture any flaky runs to GH issue "GH:flaky-smoke-2026-02-12" for future flakiness scoring.
- Add a line-item to the samples CI: fail-fast on streaming-demo runtime errors (so they don't silently pass in integration tests).

References / links
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/412
- Issue mention: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/issues/4812
- Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEXP-129

End of notes.
